|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Where Are You Taking Them?]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-04-Where_Are_You_Taking_Them-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-whereareyoutakingthem-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-04-Where_Are_You_Taking_Them.png]]) show the original text (see [[Where Are You Taking Them?]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Where Are You Taking Them?]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010): “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your gametext on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say “Coruscant?” and lose 1 Force to place a just-resolved Interrupt in owner's Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 December 2010"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “gametext” to “game text”, “just-resolved” to “just-played” and “owner's” to “owners”: “Deploy on table. At non-[Episode I] sites, immunity to attrition of [Coruscant] Jedi is limited to < 5. Your game text on [Coruscant] systems is canceled. During your control phase, may say 'Coruscant?' and lose 1 Force to place a just-played Interrupt in owners Lost Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1272_7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
